verifications.claim: Trump Accounts are tax-advantaged investment accounts for U.S. children under 18.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "tax-advantaged investment accounts for U.S. citizens under the age of 18" (R5); "new Trump accounts give eligible American children" with tax-deferred growth (R1); "new type of individual retirement account (IRA) ... for children under 18" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly describe Trump Accounts as tax-advantaged (tax-deferred) investment accounts specifically for U.S. children under 18.

verifications.claim: Trump Accounts were created by the "One Big Beautiful Bill Act".
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "As part of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act passed in July 2025" (R1); "created under last year’s One Big Beautiful Bill Act" (R2); "The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA)... created a new type of savings account" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Numerous sources explicitly state creation via the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.

verifications.claim: Children born between Jan. 1, 2025, and Dec. 31, 2028, receive a $1,000 government seed deposit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "born between January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2028... a one-time deposit of $1,000 from the U.S. government" (R1); identical phrasing in R2, R4, R5, R7, etc.
verifications.reasoning: Exact dates and $1,000 government deposit directly stated across multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Parents can open Trump Accounts via IRS Form 4547 or at TrumpAccounts.gov.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "using IRS Form 4547... or... trumpaccounts.gov website" (R2); "filing IRS Form 4547... or via TrumpAccounts.gov" (R3); "IRS Form 4547... or... trumpaccounts.gov" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm parents/guardians open via Form 4547 or TrumpAccounts.gov.

verifications.claim: 5 million Trump Accounts are already registered as of April 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "About 5 million children have been signed up for Trump Accounts" (R11, dated 2026/04/15); context of April 2026 aligns; R3 notes 4 million as of March 31
verifications.reasoning: R11 directly states 5 million signed up in April 2026 context, matching claim precisely.

verifications.claim: Trump Accounts include a $1,000 pilot contribution for 2025–2028 births.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "pilot program contribution of $1,000" for births 2025-2028 (R4); "$1,000 pilot program contribution" (R8, R9)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly describe the $1,000 as a pilot contribution for those birth years.

verifications.claim: Parents, relatives, or employers can contribute up to $5,000 annually to Trump Accounts.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "parents and others to contribute a total of up to $5,000 annually"; "employer may contribute up to $2,500... counts toward the annual limit" (R1); "family, friends and others, including employers... capped at $5,000" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Aggregate annual limit of $5,000 explicitly includes contributions from parents, relatives, others, and employers (with employer sublimit).

verifications.claim: Funds in Trump Accounts are invested in ETFs/mutual funds.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "invested in funds that track a qualified U.S. stock index" (mutual funds/ETFs implied); "mutual funds or exchange traded funds (ETFs)" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify investments limited to mutual funds or ETFs tracking U.S. indexes.

verifications.claim: Funds in Trump Accounts typically track the S&P 500.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "funds that track a qualified U.S. stock index... the S&P 500® or any other index" (R1); "track an index... like the S&P 500" (R2); "ETFs that track market indexes like the S&P 500" (R10)
verifications.reasoning: S&P 500 explicitly named as prime example/qualified index; 'typically' aligns with repeated examples.

verifications.claim: Funds in Trump Accounts grow tax-deferred.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "grow tax-deferred" (R6); "Earnings from Trump accounts are not subject to tax until... distributed" (R4); "tax-deferred investing accounts" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements confirm tax-deferred growth until withdrawal.

verifications.claim: Funds in Trump Accounts are locked until the child turns 18.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "money generally can't be withdrawn before the account owner turns 18" (R1); "can’t be withdrawn before Jan. 1 of the calendar year in which the child turns 18" (R2); growth period ends year before 18 with restricted distributions (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources uniformly state no withdrawals until age 18 (or Jan 1 of turn-18 year).

verifications.claim: Trump Accounts convert to a traditional IRA at age 18.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the account automatically converts into a traditional IRA" (R6); "account becomes subject to the same... rules governing traditional IRAs" at 18 (R1); "governed by general rules for traditional IRAs" at 18 (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm conversion to traditional IRA rules at age 18.

verifications.claim: Children must have a Social Security number for Trump Account eligibility.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "child with a Social Security number" (R1); "children under 18 who have a Social Security number" (R2); "child with a social security number" (R4); SSN required throughout (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Every source mandates SSN for eligibility.

verifications.claim: Trump Accounts can be established on TrumpAccounts.gov or by filing IRS Form 4547.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: Contributions to Trump Accounts begin July 4, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Contributions to Trump Accounts can be made starting July 4, 2026" (R8); "no earlier than July 4, 2026" (R4, R9); "Launching July 4, 2026" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Majority of sources specify contributions start July 4, 2026.
